ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure: the intersection of the central carbon skeleton extends a carbon-chain bond line to the left, upper left, and lower left respectively, and connects to the oxygen labeled OH2 to the right; there is a positive charge symbol near the oxygen, and a curved arrow is also drawn in the figure. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, ignore the arrow and charge symbol, and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. The bonds between non-hydrogen atoms include 3 C-C single bonds from the central carbon to three carbon substituents, and 1 C-O single bond from the central carbon to oxygen. The two O-H bonds and all implicit C-H bonds are not counted. Therefore the total number is 3 + 1 = 4.

method.method_draft: Describe the image, then identify the non-hydrogen framework as a central carbon bonded to three carbon groups and to an oxygen in an OH2+ group. Count the three C-C single bonds from the central carbon to the carbon substituents, then add the one C-O single bond. Exclude the two O-H bonds and all implicit C-H bonds, and ignore the curved arrow and charge symbol. Total = 3 + 1 = 4.
